key_insight: NeuroGRIP refines EEG graph predictions using retrieved clinical knowledge, making seizure diagnosis more accurate and more interpretable.
clinical_relevance: By filtering implausible EEG connections with guideline-based evidence, the approach may support more clinically grounded seizure detection.
method: Builds a domain knowledge graph from clinical guidelines using LLM-extracted entities and relations.
Projects EEG node embeddings into the knowledge space to create semantic queries.
Uses FAISS similarity search and confidence scoring to prune noisy graph edges.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved seizure detection accuracy and interpretability on TUSZ and CHB-MIT.
watch_item: Performance and reliability depend on the quality and completeness of the external knowledge base and retrieval step.
paper_title: NeuroGRIP: Retrieval-Augmented Graph Refinement for Knowledge-Grounded EEG Seizure Diagnosis
